## Container Memory Exhaustion Alert

**Threshold Breached:** Container memory utilization exceeded 85% of allocated 1GiB RAM (>870MB) for more than 5 minutes.

### Recommended Actions:
1. Cloud Run auto-scaler triggers additional instances.
2. Review heap dump and active in-memory audio buffers (`node-edge-tts` streaming chunks).
3. Check Node.js garbage collection metrics via `/api/audit`.
4. Increase container memory to 2Gi if persistent under legitimate heavy concurrent voice traffic.

**Notification Recipient:** anthonytoudou@gmail.com
**Action:** Auto-scale trigger & memory leak diagnostic review
